title: Per-tenant stochastic sampler and attested export manifest for interactive artifacts
creator: Anika Shah
description: Background: Customers require configurable retention for prompts, responses, request logs and derived metrics while minimizing storage and preserving auditability. This ticket implements a per-tenant stochastic sampling scheduler and an attested export manifest so that sampled artifacts can be reliably reproduced and handed off to compliance/legal teams with verifiable integrity. Goals: 1) Per-tenant retention policy evaluation that supports deterministic sampling seeds for reproducibility; 2) Stochastic sampler that respects tenant residency and route-level overrides; 3) Generate a signed export manifest (hash chain + signing key reference) for each evidence bundle; 4) Provide hooks for automated evidence exports to S3/GCS with optional legal-hold flags. This work should be runtime-friendly (low latency on the request path) and integrate with the existing deterministic purge orchestrator and evidence pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Operator can configure per-tenant sample rate (0-100%) and deterministic seed in the Console
Sampler runs asynchronously for high-throughput routes to avoid tail latency on generation requests
Export manifest includes: list of artifact IDs, provenance metadata (route, model version, timestamp), SHA-256 checksums, and signer key ID
Evidence bundles can be exported on-demand via API and scheduled export with region-aware residency restrictions
Samples and manifests are discoverable via the Console and downloadable as signed tarball with verification instructions
Unit and integration tests cover sampling determinism, boundary rates, and cross-region export failures
implementation_notes: Add sampler module to request-archiver service with a fast-path bypass for routes flagged 'always retain'
Use HMAC-SHA256 over (tenant_id, route_id, deterministic_seed, request_id) to derive inclusion; store seed per-tenant in metadata DB
Leverage existing evidence-export pipeline for packaging; extend manifest schema to include a signed hash chain of artifact objects
Introduce a manifest signer service that uses KMS-backed keys (integrate with customer key reference for Private deployments)
Batch checksum generation off the critical path using a worker queue and attach manifest when batch completes
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable sampling for internal tenants only; verify deterministic reproducibility across restarts
Phase 2 (opt-in): expose in Console as beta for selected customers with sample rates and seed override
Phase 3 (general): default off for new tenants; provide migration playbook for existing retention policies
Kill-switch: tenant-level and org-level disable flags; fallback to full-retention if manifest generation fails repeatedly
qa_checks: Create synthetic workload to exercise high throughput routes and verify sampler does not add >5ms p95 latency
Verify manifest signature verification using stored public key and replay hashed artifacts to confirm integrity
Simulate cross-region export failure and confirm retry/backoff and operator alerting
End-to-end test: schedule export -> manifest generated -> tarball signed -> verify checksums match stored artifact blobs
monitoring: dashboards: 'Sampler Overview' and 'Evidence Export Health' with tenant-filtering
alerts: manifest_generation_error_rate > 0.5% for 10m; export_backlog > 10k items for 15m
audit logs: record signer key id, export actor (automation/user), and destination region for each export
comments: 2025-02-20 - Anika Shah: Scoped initial design; recommending HMAC-derived determinstic inclusion to avoid global coordination. Need PM confirmation on allowed default sample rates for regulated tenants.
2025-02-25 - Priya Patel (PM): Confirmed policy: regulated tenants cannot sample below 90% retention unless explicit legal approval recorded. Added constraint to acceptance criteria.
2025-02-28 - Liam O'Connor: Prototype worker queuing done; pushing checksum computation off-path. Opening draft PR against request-archiver.
2025-03-02 - Security Review (notes): Ensure signer service supports key rotation and audit trail. Avoid transmitting plaintext tenant PII in manifests; use hashed identifiers where possible.

2025-03-04 - QA: Added test harness to validate reproducibility across service restarts; found non-determinism caused by non-stable request_id ordering in batch; plan to switch to deterministic sort before hashing. Assigned follow-up ENG-46207.
